question: Should this umbrella stay open while maintainers choose the Linux companion-app architecture now that Windows Hub is shipped, and which Linux track should become canonical?
rationale: Current main covers Windows Hub but still lacks Linux companion code, while the open Linux PRs are large, overlapping, and security-sensitive, so automation cannot safely choose the product architecture or ownership boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella and choose Linux path
options.body: Keep this tracker open, mark Windows as covered, and ask maintainers to pick one Linux architecture or split the Linux work into narrower reviewed milestones.

options.title: Split into Linux-only follow-ups
options.body: Close or retitle this umbrella after creating a canonical Linux companion issue plus separate packaging, notification, and parity follow-ups.

options.title: Close as Windows-resolved
options.body: Close this now and rely on open Linux PRs or new issues for remaining Linux work, which risks losing the umbrella product context.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and choose Linux path
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open, mark Windows as covered, and ask maintainers to pick one Linux architecture or split the Linux work into narrower reviewed milestones.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the tracker and provided the clearest product-direction comments for GTK-native Linux and iterative companion app work.
